shared_question: 请仅根据附图返回简短JSON：image_available（是否收到可观察的图像）、main_subject（主要可见内容）、button（是否可见按钮）、gripper（是否可见夹爪）、marker（是否可见标记及外观）、positions（上述可见物的大致位置）。不可见就写不可见，不要根据问题假设物体存在。

cases.content:
```json
{
  "image_available": true,
  "main_subject": "白色桌面及下方的机械臂",
  "button": "不可见",
  "gripper": "可见，左右两侧各有一个黑色机械夹爪",
  "marker": "不可见",
  "positions": {
    "main_subject": "占据画面中央大部分区域",
    "button": "不可见",
    "gripper": "分别位于画面左下角和右下角",
    "marker": "不可见"
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "image_available": true,
  "main_subject": "纯灰色背景",
  "button": "不可见",
  "gripper": "不可见",
  "marker": "不可见",
  "positions": "无"
}
```

interpretation.pixel_conditioned_behavior: The same question produced two-gripper scene, button-upper-left scene, and pure gray/no objects respectively. This supports that image pixels affect end-to-end answers and rules against total absence of image input for these probes.
interpretation.remaining_errors: Head probe missed the visible down-call button and called the panel a tabletop; wrist probe recognized the button but missed the prominent white arrow marker. Reading pixels does not imply reliable object identification.
interpretation.limits: Three single independent requests, not statistical evaluation. Does not inspect every internal decoder/cache step or guarantee correct multi-image association in all requests. No new commands executed.
